newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's March domestic debt up to 3,834 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's March domestic debt up to 3,834 trln lira.

text.p: Turkey's domestic debt rose to a provisional 3,834 trillion lire ($28.1 billion) at end-March from 3,604 trillion lire a month earlier, the Treasury said on Friday.
It said T-bills with maturities less than a year made up 2,203 trillion lira of the total domestic debt stock in March, up from 1,668 trillion lira in February.
Debt due to bonds having one-year or longer maturities were 1,160 trillion lira in March, down from 1,514 trillion lira a month ago.
The central bank's cash advances to the Treasury were up to 471 trillion lira in March from 422.4 trillion lira in February.
Turkey's domestic debt stock grew by 131.4 percent to 3,149 trillion lira in 1996, including 1,528 trillion lira of T-bill and 1,250 trillion lira of bonds.
